title: Flexible Matrix Estimation with Side Information
abstract: arXiv:2603.24833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a flexible framework for high-dimensional matrix estimation to incorporate side information for both rows and columns. Existing approaches, such as inductive matrix completion, often impose restrictive structure---for example, an exact low-rank covariate interaction term, linear covariate effects, and limited ability to exploit components explained only by one side (row or column) or by neither---and frequently omit an explicit noise component. To address these limitations, we propose to decompose the underlying matrix as the sum of four complementary components: (possibly nonlinear) interaction between row and column characteristics; row characteristic-driven component, column characteristic-driven component, and residual low-rank structure unexplained by observed characteristics. translated_title: 基于辅助信息的灵活矩阵估计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个灵活的高维矩阵估计框架，能够将行和列两方面的辅助信息纳入估计过程。现有方法（如归纳矩阵补全）往往施加了限制性结构——例如，要求精确的低秩协变量交互项、线性的协变量效应，并且难以利用仅由单侧（行或列）或双侧均无法解释的成分——而且常常省略显式的噪声成分。为解决这些局限性，我们提出将潜在矩阵分解为四个互补成分之和：（可能非线性的）行特征与列特征之间的交互项；由行特征驱动的成分；由列特征驱动的成分；以及无法由观测特征解释的残余低秩结构。通过结合基于筛（sieve）的投影与核范数惩罚，每个成分可以被分别估计……
tldr: 该论文提出将高维矩阵分解为行与列特征的非线性交互项、行特征驱动成分、列特征驱动成分及残余低秩结构四个互补成分的灵活估计框架，结合筛投影与核范数惩罚分别估计各成分，克服了归纳矩阵补全等现有方法的限制性假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a flexible framework that decomposes a high-dimensional matrix into four complementary components—possibly nonlinear row-column interactions, row-driven and column-driven components, and residual low-rank structure—estimating each separately via sieve projection with nuclear-norm penalization, thereby overcoming the restrictive assumptions of existing methods such as inductive matrix completion.
